product_name: PD1180-EPR — NEMA 34 Smart Motor-Mounted Stepper Controller with USB-C PD 3.1 EPR

requirements.input: USB-C PD 3.1 EPR 48 V / 5 A contract
requirements.motor_current_note: Conservative 3.8 A RMS ceiling, 3.781 A programmed nominal; locked initial 0.827 A / 10 rpm unloaded profile. No powered motor setting qualified.

order_hold_reasons: Exact current assembler inventory remains insufficient for U16 C2847904 and U35 C2652286. Reviewed replacements are selected for R64, U17 and J1/J10. No inventory is reserved; see stock-report.json and sourcing-resolution.md.
Alternative-part stock/package evidence includes unavailable candidates; alternatives never authorize automatic substitution.
Fabricator acceptance of filled/capped via-in-pad treatment and USB stackup/impedance remains unrecorded.
Four existing holes are retained. Actual rear thread/depth, secure motor mounting, connector access and strain relief are unverified; the 3D view is alignment-only.
TI candidate is generated and U1 unused-SBU correction is native-checked. Fixture, programming/readback, cold APP boot and FLT/EPR waveforms remain untested.

No assembled PCB has powered validation. USB startup/suspend/backfeed, supply/gate thresholds, bridge current, thermal equilibrium, brake faults and EMC require first-article evidence before running/shipping.

10 ohm / 300 W brake remains a candidate. Final load/RPM/stop duty, heatsink, guarding and resistor/harness temperatures are unqualified. Runtime voltage-continuity monitoring is implemented, but detection latency and energy absorption after a running cable open remain unqualified.
All three MCU motion/configuration/brake qualification flags remain false. A locked diagnostic image and successful CAD checks do not meet ready-to-run delivery.
TE 320559 nominal uncrimped CAD is sourced and modeled; actual finished-crimp dimensions, pull/insulation fit and retention remain unverified.
